changelog:
v5.2.4 — Favorites fixes, quicker Live TV browsing and radio channels

• Favorites that stopped opening after the October 29 catalog update are matched back to their show or movie when you open the Home screen. Any that can't be matched can now be removed with the remote: in Favorites, choose Edit, then press OK on a card.

• Removing a show or movie from Favorites (hold OK, then Favorites) now closes the info card and takes it off your Favorites list straight away.

• Your Continue Watching and watch history are no longer cleared when many of the titles in them change in the catalog at the same time. History that was already cleared can't be brought back. If a title in Continue Watching says it isn't available, open the show from Search instead.

• Live TV: press RIGHT or LEFT on a channel to move to the next or previous category, without going back up to the category bar. From Favorites (or your first category with channels), pressing LEFT twice still opens the menu.

• Settings → Clear Cache now keeps your favorites, watch history and parental controls. It clears saved pictures and the channel, movie and series lists, which download again when you open them.

• If a video keeps stopping to load, a short tip now appears with three things to try: unplug your stick for 10 seconds, restart your router (and your VPN if you use one), and clear the app's cache.

• Radio and music channels now keep playing and show an audio-only screen, instead of stopping with a "format not supported" message.

• On some TVs, a movie or episode that stopped with a picture error kept failing until you backed out and pressed Play again. The app now reopens the player for you and tries again from the same spot.

• HD Fire TV Sticks: 4K titles show the HD-version message straight away again. The 5.2.3 attempt to play 4K on these sticks didn't work well enough to keep.

• Settings → Crash Logs no longer lists app updates as crashes, or the same close more than once.
